changelog: v0.3.7: Fixed Live Mode click-click issue and perfected Half-Duplex pipeline: 1) Eliminated Android system click-click sound by completely preventing native SpeechRecognition from restarting when Whisper STT is selected; 2) Enforced strict Half-Duplex lifecycle where microphone is strictly CLOSED while Whisper is transcribing, AI is analyzing, and avatar is speaking; 3) Re-opens listening automatically after speech finishes in Live Mode; 4) Zero regressions in Regular mode.
